t: Rockridge - Oakland, CA - Reviews, rankings and crime | Niche
s: Rockridge is the best part of Oakland in terms of beautiful Craftman houses and trees, access to multiple supermarkets including Trader Joe's and Whole Foods, lots of independent shops from clothing boutiques to a great hardware store, restaurants, BART and busses, and lots of community spirit. You can walk to all part of Oakland and the UC Berkeley campus from Rockridge. All of this is what makes Rockridge an expensive place to buy a house but a perennial good investment!
